hero.title: Secure Vault
hero.description: Store and protect sensitive information with browser-based encrypted vault technology designed for privacy and security.
hero.footer: Military-grade AES-256-GCM protection. All processing is 100% local.

steps.d: Select your private documents, passwords, or recovery phrases.
Apply industrial-grade AES-256 encryption with a custom key.
Retrieve your encrypted .vault container for secure local storage.

blocked.title: Blocked Tracking Engines
blocked.note: SafeTools is a tracker-free zone. We do not inject any 3rd party scripts that could potentially compromise your session.

zeroServer.title: Zero-Server State
zeroServer.desc: SafeTools Vault never uploads your files or passwords. Encryption happens inside your browser's isolated memory sandbox.

features.title: Professional Vault Features
features.subtitle: Modern tools designed for maximum privacy and industrial-grade protection.

items.d: Your encrypted data stays on your device, never in the cloud.
Single master key protection using industrial PBKDF2 derivation.
Encrypt sensitive text, recovery phrases, and login details.
Secure any file type from PDFs to private images with AES-256.
Original filenames and MIME types are preserved inside the vault.
Works 100% offline once loaded, perfect for air-gapped systems.
One-click export and import of encrypted vault containers.
Powered by the native Web Crypto API for hardware acceleration.

architecture.title: Advanced Security Architecture
architecture.description: SafeTools Vault utilizes the same encryption standards trusted by governments and financial institutions worldwide.

items.d: The gold standard of symmetric encryption, providing both privacy and data integrity.
100,000+ iterations of HMAC-SHA256 ensures your password is hardened against brute-force.
Every encryption operation uses a unique Initialization Vector to prevent pattern analysis.

useCases.title: What Can You Protect?
useCases.subtitle: From recovery phrases to business secrets, keep everything private.

threats.title: Threat Protection
items: Protects against cloud provider data breaches
Eliminates server-side tracking and metadata harvesting
Prevents unauthorized access on shared devices
Zero exposure to plaintext storage vulnerabilities

risk.title: Reduce Data Exposure Risks
risk.desc: Traditional vaults store your data in the cloud, creating a central point of failure. SafeTools Vault eliminates this risk by keeping your data decentralized and local.

comparison.title: Why Choose SafeTools Vault?

enterprise.title: Zero-Knowledge Workflow Integration
enterprise.description: IT Security teams prefer SafeTools Vault because it eliminates the "SaaS Risk" vector. No data ever hits our infrastructure, making it compliant with strict internal privacy policies and GDPR/HIPAA standards.
items: No Vendor Lock-in: Data is stored in standard binary formats
Air-Gapped Compatible: Use on internal offline networks
Instant Deployment: No account provisioning or IT setup required
Memory Safety: Encryption handled in browser sandbox

specs.title: Technical Specifications
specs.subtitle: Deep technical details for cryptographic audits and security researchers.

offline.title: Secure Storage, Everywhere
offline.description: SafeTools Vault is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Once loaded, it functions entirely offline, ensuring you can extract your critical data even without an internet connection.

items.d: Use 16+ characters with a mix of symbols. Your password is the only key to your data.
Keep multiple copies of your .vault files on different encrypted drives.
Close the browser tab immediately after extracting sensitive files.

commitment.title: Your Data Stays Under Your Control
commitment.description: "SafeTools Vault is designed using privacy-first principles. Your encrypted data remains locally protected and is never uploaded without your permission."

faq.title: Vault FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our local encryption protocol.

items.q: Is my vault uploaded to servers?
items.a: No. All encryption and processing happen locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
Impossible. We don't have accounts, we don't store your keys, and we don't have access to your browser's memory.

items.q: What if I forget my password?
items.a: Because this is a zero-knowledge tool, we cannot recover your data. Please use a strong password you won't forget.
No. SafeTools is designed for privacy and immediate utility. No signup needed.

items.q: Can I use the vault offline?
items.a: Yes. Once the page is loaded, it works entirely offline as a PWA.
It is the industry standard for secure communications, trusted by the NSA and global financial networks.
